name: Null-safe filter excludes negative/null qty from positive aggregation
what_it_tests: The All Lines Null Safe Filter passes only LineItemQuantity >= 0 so null/negative-qty lines do not corrupt positive sums or throw an NPE
proc_mechanism: All Lines Null Safe Filter (LineItemQuantity GreaterThanOrEquals 0); Null-Check for Line Adjustment; Null-Safe Line Adjustment
expected_behavior: Negative/null qty excluded from the null-safe aggregate; no NPE
test_setup: Mixed quote: one line Qty=-1, one Qty=null, one Qty=5

prior_run.actual: Fresh mixed quote 0Q0WC000003FbDd0AK on Fortra Price Book USD, both lines NSS-SNMP Trap Receiver (PBE 01uWC000005wo41YAA, list 2800): posLine 0QLWC000003kke14AA Qty=+5, negLine 0QLWC000003kke24AA Qty=-1. PRE-reprice naive header (engine NotStarted) = Subtotal/TotalPrice/GrandTotal 11200 (= 5x2800 + (-1x2800), negative INCLUDED). V21 Force-reprice REST isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[], NO NPE; quote CalculationStatus NotStarted->CompletedWithPricing. POST-reprice: header Subtotal=14000, ALE__c=14000 (= ONLY the +5 line, negative EXCLUDED - NOT 11200). Line level: posLine TotalLineAmount=14000/Subtotal=14000; negLine TotalLineAmount=0/Subtotal=0 (negative zeroed, never subtracted). Positive-only CONTROL quote 0Q0WC000003FbIT0A0 (+5 line, no negative) repriced to the IDENTICAL Subtotal=14000/ALE__c=14000, proving the negative line contributed exactly 0 to the positive aggregate.
